##### Project general facts

Pandawa Dream is a premium leasehold project born from one of Bali’s most trusted developers, with over a decade of excellence in luxury real estate. Every detail is controlled in-house, from design and construction to management and resale, guaranteeing flawless quality. Owners gain access to an exclusive loyalty program featuring a unified booking system and the unique ability to exchange residences across the developer’s entire network of completed complexes.

Life at Pandawa Dream feels like a permanent resort getaway. Enjoy four world-class restaurants, a sleek coworking space with ultra-fast internet, a high-tech fitness center, and a premium spa. Families love the dedicated kids’ club with professional educators, while rooftop terraces offer breathtaking ocean views for sunsets and social gatherings. Expansive walkways, lush greenery, and underground parking complete a lifestyle of effortless luxury.

Every villa is finished to the highest international standards, thanks to a direct partnership with Marriott Bonvoy. Interiors feature designer furnishings, a fully equipped gourmet kitchen, and elegant decor that balances modern comfort with Balinese charm. Certified compliance with Marriott International means your home is always guest-ready, stylish, and supremely comfortable.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Badung is the crown jewel of Bali’s southern coastline, home to the island’s most famous white-sand beaches including Pandawa, Melasti, and Nusa Dua. This prestigious area offers the perfect mix of serene cliffside living and easy access to world-class dining, beach clubs, and luxury resorts. Clean roads, stunning limestone landscapes, and year-round tropical beauty make every day feel like a vacation.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional convenience and vibrant lifestyle offerings. Just a short walk from the complex, visitors can access the area’s most popular beach clubs, countless restaurants, wellness spas, and fitness centers. The neighborhood is also home to a strong international community, premium boutiques, and cultural attractions that enhance daily life. Unlike more crowded areas, this location offers a peaceful retreat without sacrificing access to world-class amenities.

For those seeking a residence that embodies both tranquility and prestige, Uluwatu delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, limited development, and proximity to the island’s finest attractions makes it a top choice for discerning investors and homeowners. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, sophisticated and effortlessly inspiring.
